correctness.rationale: The 2x2-positive corner constraint forbids VC shattering of a triple: positive diagonal pair forces the third corner. Explicit two-query witnesses handle m,n≥3 and strips, and concept counts handle 2x2 and 2x3 boundaries. A root-positive fixed-rectangle class has online rank at most two because a second positive query fixes one or both remaining row/column parameters; hence whole Ldim≤3 and strip Ldim≤2. A complete eight-leaf 3x3 depth-three tree embeds into larger grids, proving the remaining lower bounds. Independent full exact recurrence yielded (0,0),(1,1),(2,2),(2,2),(2,3),(2,3) on six grid sizes.
